messages:
Maria: quick check — PR #4782 (search/embedding sharding) is ready to merge after an approve. CI failed on the final integration job, looks like a flaky timeout. Anyone able to rerun and give approve if green?

Jon: I can trigger a rerun in ~15m. busy with standup now.

ci-bot: build 4782.1 failed on job `integ/search-remote` (shard 12) — error: `Timeout waiting for search nodes (30s)`
Logs:
```
[2026-03-18T10:03:45Z] ERROR rpc: dial tcp 10.2.3.7:9090: i/o timeout
[2026-03-18T10:03:46Z] test timeout (30s) — suite=search_integration
```

Lena: That timeout has been flaky since the infra change last week. I pushed a small retry around the client in a follow-up commit on the PR branch — it's at `pr/4782+retry`. Could we rerun against that commit? If it stays green I'll add a review.

Sam: can do the rerun now. Using `/rerun ci --job=integ/search-remote --commit=pr/4782+retry`

ci-bot: rerun started — job `integ/search-remote` on commit `pr/4782+retry` (requester: Sam)

ci-bot: rerun finished — PASS (elapsed 2m 12s). All checks green.

Jon: nice. I looked at the diff — retry is conservative and test still asserts same behavior. ok to approve once you confirm no regression, Lena?

Lena: confirmed locally (ran suite 3x). No behavioral changes, just added a backoff and extra connect attempt. I'm approving now. :white_check_mark:

Sam: approved and merging now. tagging `merge-window:immediate` — will watch deploy pipeline for 10m.

Maria: thanks all. If we see more timeouts let's open infra ticket and temporarily widen test timeout.

Sam: noted — will follow up in #eng-infra if it resurfaces. :thumbsup:
